checks.detail: Verified frozen Goal007 MANIFEST SHA ef05c2ed93247802e9a68a00d700d39a8934d6231c7787315ab37b01d2467714; all four referenced plans match byte hashes, required schedule/gt_by_scene/limits and positive integer budgets.max_output_tokens exist, and canonical identity serialization reproduces all four identities.
Exact match to generation.json_bytes: sorted keys, ensure_ascii false, allow_nan false, indent 2, final newline, UTF-8.
Immutable full schedule, selected E entry/plan/GT/artifact hashes, canonical directory and original input text hashes are checked. Actual E binder and outcomes were not executed by this reviewer.

load_scene applies stored YXZ to world XYZ; fixed cuboid schema is checked by exact re-encoding and decoding. Reference actions already use world endpoints and execute defaults world mode, so origin remains metadata and is not added twice.

Independent confusion mass checks, occupancy union, exact-material intersection/(GT+prediction-exact matches), exact material set F1, tight occupied dimensions and add/delete/replace normalization agree with frozen formulas. Aligned values use the stored certified common occupancy-optimal shift; no new alignment is claimed.
Only the seven frozen historical stone/brick lexical mappings are used. Brick and stonebrick remain distinct; no slab/fence/plank/glass merging, GT fitting or strict-metric replacement.

Original per-source Limits govern GT decode, fixed cuboid encode/decode, reference and observed action validation/execution, coordinate/operation/touched/live occupancy. Saved source files are hash-bound before parsing. Reference control success is never counted as model success.

Failed outcomes retain null metrics/no invented voxels. Original output caps and saved usage are descriptive; unknown usage stays null. Reference bytes/actions are not certified token requirements and unfinished correctness is not extrapolated.
No API/tokenizer/model/key/network call, alignment search, old artifact mutation or data-dependent alias optimization is introduced.
